math.verdict: PORTABLE — the money math is a pure, stateless, unit-explicit kernel (math.ts declares no state/clock/IO and delivers) with fail-closed nulls everywhere; every formula and default was MEASURED from source plus a zero-network synthetic proof test that pins concrete numbers. NORMAL-basis port needs ~23 rules and must reproduce the 33 fixtures below; the biggest port hazards are the three unit conventions (percent vs bps vs fraction-per-period) and the guard ORDER, which determines reject-code parity.

rules.name: executable_return_law
rules.behavior: Canonical versioned law (schema ExecutableBasisReturnContractV1, version basis-executable-long-leg-notional-v1, law RETURN_ON_LONG_LEG_ENTRY_NOTIONAL): return_pct = (sell_proceeds_price - long_entry_price) / long_entry_price * 100. Null unless BOTH prices > 0. Denominator is always the price of the leg BOUGHT at entry. One law owns both constructions.
rules.reason: Single denominator law prevents the classic which-side-do-I-divide-by bug; the old repo's own Python parity module is version-locked to it.

rules.name: entry_gap_normal
rules.behavior: Entry gap for NORMAL (buy spot, short perp): gap_in_pct = (perp_bid - spot_ask) / spot_ask * 100. Computed ONLY from real touch bid/ask — never mids, never mark price. Units: percent (0.78 means 0.78%).
rules.reason: Exactly the brief's Spot-ask-vs-Futures-bid entry; measured verbatim.

rules.name: exit_gap_pair
rules.behavior: Unwind price pair for NORMAL (sell spot at bid, buy back perp at ask): gap_out_pct = (spot_bid - perp_ask) / perp_ask * 100 under the same law. NOTE: in the old code this exact formula is the REVERSE-construction entry gap; the old runtime never priced an explicit exit P&L — its exit trigger for an open NORMAL signal was the recomputed ENTRY gap falling below watchGapPct (reason gap_closed).
rules.reason: Formula measured and correct for the exit pair; the new kernel should expose it as exit math while keeping the old entry-gap-below-watch exit trigger for behavioral parity.

rules.name: spread_bps
rules.behavior: spread_bps = (ask - bid) / mid * 10000 with mid = (bid + ask)/2. Null when bid <= 0, ask <= 0, or ask < bid (crossed book); ask == bid gives 0. Gate: either leg's spread > maxSpreadBps rejects spread_too_wide.
rules.reason: Standard mid-referenced spread; 25 bps per leg is a sane taker-arb bound.

rules.name: mark_divergence_bps
rules.behavior: divergence_bps = abs(perp_mid - mark_price) / mark_price * 10000. Null unless both > 0. Large values are treated as a bad-tick smell and degrade the data-quality composite.
rules.reason: Cheap independent cross-check of the perp book against the exchange mark.

rules.name: four_leg_fees
rules.behavior: fees_pct = 2 * spot_taker_fee_pct + 2 * perp_taker_fee_pct (open both legs + close both legs, all taker; inputs are percent PER LEG). Defaults 0.1 and 0.05 give the 0.30% round trip that matches the frozen v0 aggregate feesPct = 0.3.
rules.reason: Correct 4-leg model; defaults are Binance no-discount taker rates — re-verify against the live venue fee tier at deploy time.

rules.name: ladder_slippage_walk
rules.behavior: Walk depth rows [price, base_qty] best-first consuming notional_usd: per row take_usd = min(remaining, price*qty), accumulate cost_usd and filled_base = take/price; avg_px = cost_usd/filled_base; slippage_pct = abs(avg_px - touch) / touch * 100. Null when ladder empty, notional <= 0, touch <= 0, or the ladder cannot cover the size.
rules.reason: Exact average-fill-vs-touch definition; the null on underfill is load-bearing (triggers the penalty rule).

rules.name: thin_ladder_penalty
rules.behavior: Ladder exists but cannot fill the intended size: per-leg slippage = slippagePctEstimate * 4 (default 0.20%).
rules.reason: Deliberate fail-expensive placeholder; in practice the depth gate usually rejects first, this just keeps net edge pessimistic.

rules.name: top_of_book_slippage
rules.behavior: No ladder: per-leg slippage = base * max(1, consumption / 0.25) with consumption = notional_usd / (touch_px * touch_qty) and base = slippagePctEstimate / 2 (0.025%). Consuming <= 25% of visible touch costs the base estimate; scales linearly beyond. Invalid touch inputs (px/qty/notional <= 0) return base * 4. Self-described as crude by design: monotonic, explainable penalty, not a microstructure thesis.
rules.reason: Honest fallback with documented intent; keep for parity, revisit only with real fill data.

rules.name: total_slippage_legs
rules.behavior: slippage_pct = spot_leg + perp_leg, each leg priced on the side the direction must HIT. NORMAL entry hits spot ASKS and perp BIDS. Each leg independently picks ladder walk vs top-of-book fallback.
rules.reason: Round-trip cost needs both legs; side selection is direction-critical and measured.

rules.name: depth_score
rules.behavior: Per leg: visible_usd = sum(price*qty) over the hit-side ladder (fallback: touch px*qty; null if neither); coverage = visible_usd / notional_usd; score = clamp(log10(1 + coverage) / log10(11), 0, 1). So 10x coverage = 1.0 exactly, 1x coverage = 0.2890648 (note: BELOW the 0.3 gate — default gate needs ~1.05x visible coverage). Pair score = min(spot_leg, perp_leg); null if either leg null. Gate: score < minDepthScore rejects depth_too_thin.
rules.reason: Smooth log coverage curve with an exact 10x=1.0 anchor; two-leg min is the right conservatism.

rules.name: funding_carry_discrete_settlements
rules.behavior: Carry accrues ONLY at discrete funding timestamps crossed by the hold. If ms_to_next_funding > hold_ms: carry = 0. Else crossings = 1 + floor((hold_ms - ms_to_next) / period_ms). If crossings exceed the count of KNOWN settlement rates: carry = null (a crossed settlement with no known rate stays unknown — never prorated from the current rate). Null guards: hold_ms finite >= 0, period_ms > 0, ms_to_next > 0, crossings a safe integer, every rate finite with abs(rate) <= 0.1. carry_pct = sum over crossed settlements of rate * 100 * sign; sign = +1 for long_spot_short_perp (the short perp leg RECEIVES positive funding), -1 for the other direction.
rules.reason: The discrete-settlement model (vs naive time-prorating) is the most defensible funding decision in the file; null-on-unknown is fail-closed money math.

rules.name: unit_conventions
rules.behavior: Three unit regimes coexist: (1) gaps, fees, slippage, carry, drag, borrow cost, net edge = PERCENT (x100); (2) spreads and mark divergence = BPS (x10000); (3) funding rate = FRACTION per settlement period (0.0001 = 1bp = 0.01%), converted to percent by x100 inside carry. Borrow hourlyRatePct = percent per hour. The 0.1 sanity cap on funding is 10% per period expressed as a fraction.
rules.reason: Mixing x100 and x10000 is the single most likely differential-harness failure; the new kernel must document and test these explicitly.

rules.name: flip_risk_discount
rules.behavior: flip_risk = clamp(0.6 * sign_flip_share + 0.4 * clamp(1 - abs(rate)/0.0005, 0, 1), 0, 1), computed from >= 3 finite history rates (null otherwise); sign_flip_share = consecutive nonzero sign changes / (n-1). POSITIVE raw carry is discounted: carry = raw * (1 - flip_risk); NEGATIVE carry is never discounted (pessimistic about drag). Unknown flip risk leaves positive carry undiscounted.
rules.reason: The asymmetric discount (haircut the bonus, never the drag) is sound and worth keeping; the 0.6/0.4 weights and 5bp anchor are hand-tuned — reproduce for parity, then re-fit.

rules.name: expected_hold
rules.behavior: If gap_pct > 0 and slope_pct_per_min < -1e-6 (closing): hold_ms = clamp((gap_pct / abs(slope)) * 60000, minHoldMs, maxHoldMs). Widening or flat gaps: clamp(defaultHoldMs, min, max). This hold feeds the funding-carry settlement count.
rules.reason: Simple convergence-time estimate with sane clamps (4h default, 10min floor, 24h cap).

rules.name: funding_freshness_fail_closed
rules.behavior: Carry is computed only from a fresh mark observation: finite rate with abs <= 0.1, mark_price > 0, ts a positive safe integer, staleness within [-maxFutureSkewMs, fundingStaleMs], and next_funding_ts strictly > now (a past schedule cannot manufacture a settlement). Anything else: carry = null, funding not fresh, scanner rejects data_stale. Net edge is NEVER computed by assuming zero funding.
rules.reason: Fail-closed on funding is a money-safety invariant the tests pin repeatedly (NaN rate, missing mark, stale mark, past nextFundingTs all end in data_stale).

rules.name: cost_assembly
rules.behavior: funding_drag_pct = max(0, -carry_pct) (drag only; >= 0). total_costs_pct = fees_pct + slippage_pct + funding_drag_pct + borrow_cost_pct (borrow = 0 for NORMAL). Positive carry is NOT inside costs — it enters only as the net-edge bonus.
rules.reason: Itemised breakdown makes every proposal auditable; drag/bonus separation avoids double counting.

rules.name: net_edge
rules.behavior: net_pct = gross_pct - total_costs_pct + max(0, carry_pct). net is NULL when gross is null OR carry is unknown (null) — even though the cost breakdown is still assembled treating unknown carry as 0 for display. The carry used is the flip-risk-discounted value.
rules.reason: The full expected-net formula; null-propagation on unknown carry is the fail-closed behavior the differential harness must match.

rules.name: entry_thresholds
rules.behavior: gap < watchGapPct: ignore (not a reject). While persistence accrues: kind = focus if gap >= focusGapPct else watch. edge_below_fees when gross <= fees_pct + slippage_pct (ONLY those two terms — drag and borrow are gated separately). funding_against_trade when funding_drag_pct > maxFundingDragPct. gap_not_persistent when stability_cv > maxGapCv AND persist_ticks < persistTicks. edge_below_threshold when net < minNetBasisPct. Proposal only after persistTicks consecutive qualifying ticks (2s tick cadence).
rules.reason: watchGapPct 0.15 / focusGapPct 0.3 / minNet 0.25 / persist 5 are the owner's documented posture (v0 header cites fees 0.30%, min net 0.25%); tests routinely override persistTicks to 3 — keep it a parameter.

rules.name: gap_stability_stats
rules.behavior: Over the tracking window: sample mean; sample stdDev with n-1 denominator (null under 2 samples); cv = stdDev / max(abs(mean), 1e-9). Slope: least-squares fit of value vs time with x = (ts - t0)/60000 (minutes), slope = (n*Sxy - Sx*Sy)/(n*Sxx - Sx^2), null with < 2 samples or denominator < 1e-12. Units: pct per minute, positive = widening.
rules.reason: Textbook stats with explicit degeneracy guards; window of 60 samples at 2s ticks = 2 minutes of gap history.

rules.name: dq_composite
rules.behavior: score = min(spot_fresh, perp_fresh, mark_fresh) * (0.5 + 0.5*skew_comp) * (0.6 + 0.4*div_comp) * ladder_comp, clamped 0..1. Freshness components = clamp(1 - staleness/limit, 0, 1) (books use staleMs, mark uses fundingStaleMs; never-seen = 0). skew_comp = clamp(1 - leg_skew/maxLegSkewMs, 0, 1), 0.5 when unknown. div_comp = clamp(1 - divergence_bps/maxMarkDivergenceBps, 0, 1), 0.75 when unknown. ladder_comp = 1.0 when ladder-backed else 0.7. Gate: score < minDataQuality rejects data_stale. Separate hard gates fire first: either book staler than staleMs, or leg_skew > maxLegSkewMs (a gap across skewed books is fiction).
rules.reason: The freshness-backbone-times-modifiers shape is sensible but the 0.5/0.6/0.75/0.7 constants are hand-tuned; reproduce exactly for differential parity, then consider simplifying.

rules.name: config_validation_invariants
rules.behavior: Reject config unless: watchGapPct <= focusGapPct; minHoldMs <= defaultHoldMs <= maxHoldMs; maxHoldMs/fundingPeriodMs <= 1000; rolling windows (gapWindowSize, fundingHistoryKeep) >= 3; minNetBasisPct, watchGapPct, maxFundingDragPct strictly > 0; every numeric finite and range-checked; config content identity rejects negative zero. Changing any effective money threshold produces a new config version, expires open proposals (reason config_changed) and clears signal-derived priorities.
rules.reason: Cheap invariants that each block a real footgun; invalidate-derived-state-on-config-change is a correctness behavior, not hygiene.

rules.name: money_control_flags
rules.behavior: App-level flags that changed money behavior (there is no basis-local feature-flag registry — assigned features.ts is the per-tick snapshot builder): killSwitch defaults ON (halted), liveTradingEnabled false, fundsLocked true, automationPaused true, borrowing/funds control modes blocked. Under kill switch the scanner keeps evaluating but converts a would-be proposal into reject kill_switch_on, and the intent bridge blocks with a ledgered risk_rejected. Pausing basis intake blocks intents AND expires the already-open proposal. Runtime feesPct/minNetBasisPct edits are clamped (0..10 and 0..100) and flow through config revision.
rules.reason: Control plane rather than math, but two behaviors must survive the port: fail-closed defaults (starts halted) and see-but-cannot-arm under kill switch.

funding.verdict: PORT. Every focus behavior is a small pure deterministic function with no I/O; the whole area is reproducible in ~200 lines of Python. Basis: MEASURED — every fixture below was produced by executing the original TS logic (copies diff-verified logic-identical, only import specifiers rewritten) under node --experimental-strip-types, cross-checked against the old suite server/test/engine-basis.mjs. Clone: current-main @ 475bd57. Critical discipline for the port: fundingRate is a FRACTION per period (0.0001 = 1 bps); carry/slippage/fees outputs are PERCENT of notional; divergence and spreads are bps.

rules.name: expected_hold_from_gap_slope
rules.behavior: hold_ms = clamp((gapPct / -slopePctPerMin) minutes -> ms, minHoldMs, maxHoldMs) only when gapPct > 0 AND slopePctPerMin < -1e-6 (gap closing); widening, flat, near-zero slope, or null gap falls back to clamp(defaultHoldMs, min, max). Units: gapPct in pct, slope in pct/min.
rules.reason: Simple, explainable hold estimate; clamps defend against absurd extrapolation.

rules.name: funding_carry_discrete_settlements
rules.behavior: carryPct = sum over crossed settlements of rate_i * 100 * sign, where sign = +1 for long_spot_short_perp (short perp RECEIVES positive funding) and -1 for short_spot_long_perp. Crossed settlements: 0 if msToNextFunding > holdMs (carry = 0, no proration); else count = 1 + floor((holdMs - msToNextFunding) / fundingPeriodMs). Returns null (unknown, fail closed) when: count exceeds the known-rates list; any used rate non-finite or |rate| > 0.1 fraction; msToNextFunding <= 0; holdMs < 0 or non-finite; periodMs <= 0. Input rates are per-period fractions; output is pct of notional.
rules.reason: The core law: funding is charged only at known discrete settlement timestamps, never time-prorated; an unknown future settlement rate poisons the estimate to null rather than being guessed.

rules.name: only_current_rate_is_known
rules.behavior: The engine passes exactly [currentFundingRate] as the known-settlement list, and 'next funding' is a TIMESTAMP only — the next period's rate is never assumed. Consequence: any expected hold that crosses >= 2 settlements yields carry = null, which the scanner converts to a data_stale refusal. Long expected holds fail closed by design (old test 5b: 17h hold, 8h period -> null).
rules.reason: Deliberate epistemic honesty; a differential port must not 'improve' this by prorating or extrapolating the current rate.

rules.name: funding_freshness_gate
rules.behavior: Funding context is fresh only if ALL hold: mark exists; fundingRate finite and |rate| <= 0.1 fraction; markPrice finite > 0; mark.ts safe integer > 0; markStalenessMs known and within [-maxFutureSkewMs, fundingStaleMs]; nextFundingTs safe integer and STRICTLY > now. Not fresh -> context is all-null (fresh=false, rate/carry/flipRisk/msToFunding null, captureFactor 0, expectedHoldMs still computed, reported staleness floored at 0) and the scanner refuses with data_stale.
rules.reason: Fail-closed: a past nextFundingTs or stale mark cannot manufacture a settlement.

rules.name: funding_flip_risk
rules.behavior: Needs >= 3 finite history rates, else null. flipShare = signFlips / (n-1), counting a flip only when consecutive rates have different sign AND both are nonzero (zero-touching transitions are not flips). magRisk = clamp(1 - |rate|/0.0005, 0, 1) using the current rate if finite else the last history rate (0.0005 fraction = 5 bps/period = confident sign; ~0 = coin toss). flipRisk = clamp(0.6*flipShare + 0.4*magRisk, 0, 1).
rules.reason: Formula is load-bearing for the carry discount; the 0.6/0.4 weights are arbitrary-old-defaults but only modulate a bonus, so keep for parity and tune later.

rules.name: flip_discount_asymmetry
rules.behavior: carry = rawCarry * (1 - flipRisk) only when rawCarry > 0 and flipRisk is known; NEGATIVE carry is never discounted. An unreliable bonus is not a bonus; drag is taken at face value.
rules.reason: Deliberate pessimism asymmetry — discounting drag would understate risk.

rules.name: capture_factor
rules.behavior: captureFactor = clamp(1 - msToFunding/fundingPeriodMs, 0, 1) only when RAW (pre-discount) carry > 0 AND msToFunding <= holdMs; else 0. A paying settlement landing inside the hold earns a priority bump, more if imminent. Metadata for priority ranking only — not a gate.
rules.reason: Cheap, explainable priority signal; uses raw carry so flip-discount does not zero the bump.

rules.name: funding_ingestion_and_history
rules.behavior: A markFunding tick is stored only if: in-order (ts >= previous), fresh within fundingStaleMs, markPrice finite > 0, rate finite with |rate| <= 0.1, and nextFundingTs is null or inside [ts - maxFutureSkewMs, ts + 2*fundingPeriodMs]. An INVALID tick CLEARS the stored mark (fail closed, no last-good reuse). History: a point is appended only when the rate differs from the last stored point (history = rate-CHANGE events, not per-period samples), bounded to fundingHistoryKeep newest; seeding sorts by ts, drops duplicate ts, filters |rate| > 0.1 and future ts.
rules.reason: Fail-closed ingestion is what makes downstream nulls trustworthy; flipShare semantics depend on the change-event dedup.

rules.name: funding_drag_refusal
rules.behavior: Cost assembly: fundingDragPct = max(0, -carryPct) enters costs; positive carry is added back to net edge separately. Scanner refusal: if fundingDragPct > maxFundingDragPct -> reject funding_against_trade (after fees check, before borrow/stability/net-edge). If carry is null (unknown/stale) -> reject data_stale ('funding unavailable or stale') earlier in the ladder, and net edge is forced null.
rules.reason: 0.15% of notional over the hold is a coherent bound relative to fees 0.3% + minNet 0.25%.

rules.name: liquidity_sides
rules.behavior: Direction A (long_spot_short_perp) consumes spot ASKS + perp BIDS; direction B (short_spot_long_perp) consumes spot BIDS + perp ASKS. All depth walking, depth scoring, and touch-fallbacks use exactly these sides; book pressure compares them to the opposite sides.
rules.reason: Executable-side discipline — mid-based liquidity would be fiction.

rules.name: depth_score_at_size
rules.behavior: Per leg: visibleUsd = sum(px*qty) over ALL levels of the consumed ladder side; if no ladder, visibleUsd = touchPx*touchQty; no data or notional <= 0 -> null. coverage = visibleUsd/notionalUsd; legScore = clamp01(log10(1+coverage)/log10(11)) so 10x coverage -> 1.0, 1x -> ~0.289, <1x proportionally poor. Combined depthScore = min(spotLeg, perpLeg) — a two-leg trade is only as deep as its thinner leg; null if either leg is null.
rules.reason: Monotonic, size-aware, explainable; the min() across legs is the safety property.

rules.name: ladder_slippage_walk
rules.behavior: Walk the consumed side best-first, taking min(remainingUsd, px*qty) per level, accumulating costUsd and filledBase = take/px. If the ladder cannot fill the notional -> null, and the caller substitutes penalty slippage = slippagePctEstimate * 4 for that leg. Else avgPx = costUsd/filledBase and slippagePct = |avgPx - touch|/touch * 100 (touch = first level price; touch <= 0 or empty ladder or notional <= 0 -> null).
rules.reason: Exact average-fill vs touch; the x4 penalty keeps thin ladders economically radioactive without refusing here (depth gate refuses).

rules.name: top_of_book_slippage_fallback
rules.behavior: When a leg has no ladder: base = slippagePctEstimate / 2; invalid touch (px, qty, or notional <= 0) -> base * 4; else slippage = base * max(1, consumption/0.25) where consumption = notionalUsd/(touchPx*touchQty) — consuming <= 25% of visible touch costs the base estimate, beyond that scales linearly. Total slippagePct = spot leg + perp leg (both directions, both models mixable per leg). ladderBacked = true only when BOTH legs had ladders.

Components (each 1 = pristine): book fresh = clamp01(1 - stalenessMs/staleMs), null staleness -> 0 + reason leg_never_seen; markFresh = clamp01(1 - markStalenessMs/fundingStaleMs), null -> 0 + funding_never_seen, over limit adds funding_stale; skewComp = 0.5 when legSkew unknown, else clamp01(1 - legSkewMs/maxLegSkewMs), over limit adds leg_timestamp_skew; divComp = 0.75 when mark or perp mid unknown (mild distrust), else clamp01(1 - divergenceBps/maxMarkDivergenceBps) with divergenceBps = |perpMid - mark|/mark * 10000, over limit adds mark_book_divergence; ladderComp = 1 if ladder-backed else 0.7. rules.name: depth_ladder_ingestion

Invalid/stale -> stored ladder CLEARED (leg falls back to top-of-book slippage model). Books similarly: finite positive px/qty, bid <= ask, in-order, fresh — invalid clears.
rules.reason: The walk assumes best-first sorted uncrossed ladders; ingestion is what guarantees it.

rules.name: executable_gap_law
rules.behavior: Normal basis (direction long_spot_short_perp): gap_pct = (perp_bid - spot_ask) / spot_ask * 100. Return on the long-leg entry notional (contract 'basis-executable-long-leg-notional-v1'). Executable bid/ask only, never mid or mark. null unless both prices > 0.
rules.reason: Core economics; frozen versioned contract in math.ts.

rules.name: watch_and_focus_thresholds
rules.behavior: gap < watchGapPct -> decision 'ignore' AND persistence resets. While persisting but persistTicks < required: kind = 'focus' if gap >= focusGapPct else 'watch'. Config validation enforces 0 < watchGapPct <= focusGapPct.
rules.reason: Coherent with the 0.3% round-trip fee floor (watch = half fees, focus = fee breakeven); keep tunable.

rules.name: persistence_counting
rules.behavior: persistTicks = consecutive engine ticks (tick cadence tickMs) with gap >= watchGapPct, per symbol+direction. openedTs latched at first crossing; gapAgeMs = now - openedTs. Any tick below watch OR with gap null/non-finite resets ticks to 0 and age to null. Proposal requires persistTicks >= cfg.persistTicks after all economic guards pass.
rules.reason: The anti-noise debounce; default 5 ticks x 2s = 10s. Old proof suite runs with 3 — 5 is the frozen v0 default.

rules.name: gap_sample_window
rules.behavior: Rolling per symbol+direction window of (ts, gap_pct) samples, capped at gapWindowSize by dropping oldest. Slope and CV are computed from it. Missing-gap ticks add no sample (window is not cleared, only persistence resets).
rules.reason: 60 samples ~ 2 min at 2s ticks; config validation requires >= 3.

rules.name: slope_pct_per_min
rules.behavior: Least-squares slope over window samples with x = (ts - ts_first)/60000 minutes, y = gap pct. Returns null when < 2 samples or |n*Sxx - Sx^2| < 1e-12 (indistinct timestamps). Positive = widening, negative = closing. Also feeds expectedHoldMs: if gap > 0 and slope < -1e-6, hold_ms = clamp((gap/-slope) minutes, minHoldMs, maxHoldMs), else defaultHoldMs.
rules.reason: Simple, explainable trend estimate reused by priority momentum and hold estimation.

rules.name: stability_cv
rules.behavior: stabilityCv = sample_stddev(n-1 denominator) / max(|mean|, 1e-9), computed over ONLY the last max(2*persistTicks, 6) samples of the window (all-window CV would punish a gap for having opened at all). null when < 3 recent samples.
rules.reason: Flickering-gap detector; the recent-window slice is deliberate and load-bearing.

rules.name: stability_guard
rules.behavior: Reject 'gap_not_persistent' ONLY when stabilityCv is non-null AND stabilityCv > maxGapCv AND persistTicks < required persistTicks. A gap that already persisted N ticks is immune to the CV reject (both conditions required).
rules.reason: The AND is the hysteresis: survived persistence overrides noisiness. 0.6 is a judgment default — keep tunable.

rules.name: feed_freshness_guard
rules.behavior: Reject 'data_stale' when either leg staleness is null (never seen — fails closed) or > staleMs. Staleness = max(0, now - book.ts). Funding leg: not fresh, fundingRate null, or carry unknown -> also 'data_stale' (funding fresh requires markStaleness <= fundingStaleMs, |rate| <= 0.1, nextFundingTs > now).
rules.reason: Null-fails-closed is the core safety posture; 5s/10s match 2s tick cadence.

rules.name: cross_market_skew_guard
rules.behavior: legSkewMs = |spot_book.ts - perp_book.ts|. If > maxLegSkewMs -> reject 'data_stale' (a cross-market gap computed from books cut at different times is fiction). Checked at scan time and again independently for causality pairs.
rules.reason: Prevents phantom gaps from asynchronous feeds; 2.5s ~ one tick + margin.

rules.name: data_quality_composite
rules.behavior: score = min(spotFresh, perpFresh, markFresh) * (0.5 + 0.5*skewComp) * (0.6 + 0.4*divComp) * ladderComp, clamped 0..1. freshComp = clamp(1 - staleness/limit, 0, 1) with limit staleMs (books) / fundingStaleMs (mark); null staleness -> 0 + suspect reason. skewComp = clamp(1 - legSkew/maxLegSkewMs, 0, 1), 0.5 when skew unknown. divComp = clamp(1 - markDivergenceBps/maxMarkDivergenceBps, 0, 1), 0.75 when mark unknown. ladderComp = 1 if depth-ladder-backed else 0.7. Reject 'data_stale' when score < minDataQuality.
rules.reason: Freshness-backbone structure is sound; the modulation weights (0.5/0.5, 0.6/0.4, 0.7, 0.75) are arbitrary old defaults — reproduce for differential parity, then retune.

rules.name: mark_divergence
rules.behavior: markDivergenceBps = |perp_mid - mark| / mark * 10000. Feeds the dq composite only — there is NO direct divergence reject; a divergent mark surfaces as data_stale via the quality score.
rules.reason: Bad-tick smell test; indirect gating is intentional (mark is advisory, books are truth).

rules.name: future_timestamp_guard
rules.behavior: Ingest accepts a timestamp only when now - ts is in [-maxFutureSkewMs, maxAge]. Source event times must additionally be safe integers > 0, fresh within staleMs, and <= receipt_ts + maxFutureSkewMs. Violations invalidate the observation (book cleared, not priced).
rules.reason: Small clock-skew allowance; anything further in the future is rejected.

rules.name: ingest_book_validity
rules.behavior: A book is accepted only if bid, ask, bidQty, askQty are finite, > 0, <= 1e15 and bid <= ask. Invalid/crossed/stale input CLEARS the live book (subsequent scan rejects spot_missing/perp_missing) rather than pricing it. Unknown symbols allocate nothing.
rules.reason: Trust boundary: malformed data never enters live state.

rules.name: ingest_monotonicity_and_watermarks
rules.behavior: Receipt-ts regressions never replace the live book. For changed prices: source-event-time below the per-symbol accepted max or per-leg watermark -> SOURCE_CLOCK_REVERSAL; sequence regression -> SOURCE_SEQUENCE_REVERSAL; identical source stamp with a different price -> SOURCE_REPLAY_CONFLICT; receipt-clock regression -> RECEIPT_CLOCK_REVERSAL. Any DISCONTINUITY resets causal lifecycles for both directions of the symbol. Watermarks survive missing/invalid book clears (a delayed old cut cannot re-bootstrap behind an accepted newer one); only the explicit restart fence (resetBookContinuity) clears watermarks — and it also clears the whole gap tracker.
rules.reason: Keep clock-reversal and replay guards; sequence guards only apply if the new feed supplies sequences — port conditionally.

rules.name: causal_pair_usable
rules.behavior: Both the before AND after pair of an accepted book event are judged at that event's own acceptedAtMs: each leg age (max(0, acceptedAt - leg.ts)) <= staleMs AND |spot.ts - perp.ts| <= maxLegSkewMs, else causality is reset for the symbol. A later refresh of the opposite leg can never make a stale/over-skewed baseline look usable after the fact.
rules.reason: Anti-laundering rule; only needed if the causality sub-machine is ported.

rules.name: causal_lifecycle_attribution
rules.behavior: Evidence-only (never gates decisions). Per direction, from an accepted single-initiator book event: delta = gap_after - gap_before. Start a lifecycle only when gap_after >= watchGapPct AND |delta| >= causalMoveThresholdPct AND trend known (delta != 0); quadrant = {RISING|FALLING}_{SPOT|PERPETUAL}_LED, baseline = gap_before, persistenceEvents = 1, evolution GROWING, follower = the other market, confirmation PENDING. Advance on same-market same-trend significant moves (GROWING) or insignificant nonzero drifts (GROWING/DECAYING by distance from baseline), persistenceEvents capped at gapWindowSize. Follower CONFIRMED only when the other market's executable quote (dir A: perp->bid, spot->ask; dir B: spot->bid, perp->ask) moves in the initiator's price direction while the gap decays toward baseline -> evolution DECAYING. Trend flip or initiator price-trend flip restarts the lifecycle (fresh source, age 0, persistence 1). Resolved (cleared) when the gap crosses back through baseline. Expired when now - initiatedAtAcceptedMs > causalExpiryMs (accepted-at clock; public ageMs uses the source clock: now - initiatingSourceTs). Everything unprovable reports UNKNOWN.
rules.reason: Large observability sub-machine; decisions are identical without it. Port later if initiator attribution is wanted in the new UI; defer from the minimal kernel.

rules.name: universe_filter
rules.behavior: Runtime eligibility predicate: hasSpot AND hasPerp AND finite(quoteVolume24hUsd) AND quoteVolume24hUsd >= minQuoteVolume24hUsd. Engine meta validation: quote must be 'USDT', symbol must equal base+quote, symbol/asset regexes ^[A-Z0-9]{2,32}$ / ^[A-Z0-9]{1,16}$, eligible implies hasSpot AND hasPerp. setUniverse REPLACES the universe; > maxUniverseSize throws (never silently truncates). Departed symbols drop tracker buckets, lifecycle, priority rows and expire their proposals immediately.
rules.reason: $3M 24h floor is a judgment default but reasonable; the replace-not-append and prune-derived-state semantics are load-bearing.

rules.name: symbol_policy_gate
rules.behavior: symbolAllowed = (allowlist is null OR contains symbol) AND not policy-blocked AND not operator-blocked AND meta.eligible. Blocked -> reject 'symbol_blocked' before any direction evaluation. Operator overlay survives application-config refresh; blocking expires open proposals for the symbol.
rules.reason: Two independent blocklists (policy vs operator) prevented refreshes from silently unblocking.

rules.name: guard_ladder_order
rules.behavior: Frozen per-direction order — the FIRST failing guard names the reject: (1) spot book missing -> spot_missing; (2) perp missing -> perp_missing; (3) book staleness -> data_stale; (4) leg skew -> data_stale; (5) dq score -> data_stale; (6) funding missing/stale -> data_stale; (7) gap not computable -> book_missing; (8) gap < watch -> ignore; (9) either leg spreadBps > maxSpreadBps -> spread_too_wide (spreadBps = (ask-bid)/mid*10000); (10) depthScore null or < minDepthScore -> depth_too_thin; (11) gap <= feesPct+slippagePct -> edge_below_fees (fees = 2*spotTakerFeePct + 2*perpTakerFeePct); (12) fundingDragPct > maxFundingDragPct -> funding_against_trade; (13) [direction B only: borrow guards — out of scope]; (14) stability CV guard -> gap_not_persistent; (15) netEdge null or < minNetBasisPct -> edge_below_threshold; (16) persistTicks short -> watch/focus; else proposal. Reject vocabulary is the frozen 16-code set, never invented per run.
rules.reason: Order is deliberate (structure -> data quality -> existence -> cost -> stability -> threshold -> persistence); economics rejects fire BEFORE the persistence gate, so a thin edge never even watches.

rules.name: direction_pick
rules.behavior: Both directions evaluated independently each tick; pick by kind rank proposal(5) > focus(4) > watch(3) > reject(2) > ignore(1); equal rank -> larger gapPct wins (null gap = -infinity); exact tie -> direction A (long_spot_short_perp). Persistence/stability state is tracked per symbol+direction.
rules.reason: Actionable kinds outrank rejects; economically bigger gap is primary.

rules.name: kill_switch_and_intake_pause
rules.behavior: Kill switch converts a picked 'proposal' into reject 'kill_switch_on' AFTER evaluation — observation, watching, and focus continue; only arming stops. Intake pause similarly converts proposals to reject 'intake_paused' at the engine layer and expires open proposals.
rules.reason: 'The engine keeps seeing, it just cannot arm' — preserves signal history through operational stops.

rules.name: priority_ranking
rules.behavior: score = netEdgeN * max(persistenceN, 0.1) * max(liquidityN, 0.05) * fundingUsefulness * dqScore * momentum. netEdgeN = clamp(netEdgePct/(2*minNetBasisPct), 0, 1.5); persistenceN = clamp(persistTicks/persistTicks_required, 0, 1); liquidityN = clamp(depthScore, 0, 1); fundingUsefulness = clamp(0.5 + carryPct/(2*maxFundingDragPct) + 0.25*captureFactor, 0, 1); dqScore = clamp(dq, 0, 1); momentum = clamp(1 + priorityMomentumWeight*tanh(slopePctPerMin/watchGapPct), 0.5, 1.5). All components shipped with the score (explainability).
rules.reason: Multiplicative explainable model is worth keeping; the floors and 0.25 weight are arbitrary old defaults — reproduce for parity, retune with data.

rules.name: focus_capacity_hysteresis
rules.behavior: Focus is scarce. Already-focused symbols refresh score and stay. Unpinned admission: size < softCap -> free entry; softCap <= size < hardCap -> enter only if score > weakest unpinned (pool grows, NO eviction); size >= hardCap -> evict weakest unpinned iff strictly stronger, else deny. Pinned always enters (at hard cap evicts weakest unpinned; denied only if everything is pinned). Denied symbols stay WATCHING candidates. Unpinned focus sessions older than focusMaxAgeMs are closed (max_focus_time) back to WATCHING.
rules.reason: Score-based eviction with a soft/hard band is the promote/demote discipline; hard cap is never exceeded.

rules.name: cooldown_and_candidate_ttl
rules.behavior: A reject that lands while the symbol is FOCUS or PROPOSED ('advanced signal died with a named reason') -> COOLDOWN until now + cooldownMs; cooldown symbols are wholly skipped by the tick (no decisions at all) until expiry, then IDLE with correlation cleared. Proposal expiry (gap_closed / ttl / conditions broke) -> same cooldown. A shallow reject (never advanced) -> REJECTED, then back to IDLE after > 2*tickMs. WATCHING candidates older than candidateTtlMs expire to IDLE. 'watch' while FOCUS/PROPOSED closes focus (signal weakened below focus grade but alive) -> WATCHING. 'ignore' closes everything -> IDLE.
rules.reason: Anti-flapping core: a died advanced signal cannot re-arm for 10 min; dropping tracker state on cooldown means persistence restarts honestly.

rules.name: tracker_memory_bounds
rules.behavior: Gap tracker holds at most 2*maxUniverseSize buckets (symbol x 2 directions); overflow buckets are transient (computed but not stored). Universe refresh prunes buckets for departed symbols; per-symbol reset drops both directions; lifecycle map similarly capped at maxUniverseSize.
rules.reason: Bounded state under adversarial symbol churn.

rules.name: legacy_mark_scanner
rules.behavior: LEGACY server/src/engine/scanner.ts (superseded): gap = |basisPct| from spot vs perp MARK price (not executable bid/ask). Open hysteresis: ticksAbove >= persistTicks with gross >= feesPct + minNetBasisPct (0.55%). Exit hysteresis: proposal closes only after ticksBelow >= persistTicks consecutive ticks with gross < feesPct (0.3%) — an ASYMMETRIC enter/exit band with N-tick debounce on both sides; any tick back above fees resets ticksBelow. Missing/stale evidence or volume floor failure retires state immediately (approvability removed before persistence writes).
rules.reason: Mark-price gap is not executable — superseded by the basis engine's bid/ask law. ONE idea worth stealing (ADAPT candidate): the debounced asymmetric exit band; the new engine instead closes via proposal invalidation at a single threshold.

Two scanner.ts files exist; the canonical one for this area is server/src/engine/basis/scanner.ts. server/src/engine/scanner.ts is the older mark-price monitor with asymmetric enter(0.55%)/exit(0.3%) N-tick hysteresis — mined, verdict REJECT except the exit-band idea.

persistTicks frozen v0 default is 5; the old proof suite overrides to 3 — fixtures state which config they assume. Proposal fires on the tick where persistTicks reaches the requirement (observe increments before the scanner evaluates).

Two subtle orderings worth preserving in the port: (a) economics rejects (fees/threshold/funding) fire BEFORE the persistence watch/focus gate, so weak edges never enter watching; (b) the stability CV reject requires persistTicks < required — survived persistence overrides noisiness.

Cooldown is a full scan skip (the symbol produces zero decisions while cooling), and entering cooldown does not clear tracker samples — but universe departure and config revision DO clear tracker state (gaps.clear on updateConfig, retainSymbols on setUniverse).

Config validation worth porting: watchGapPct <= focusGapPct, causalMoveThresholdPct in (0, watchGapPct), minHold <= defaultHold <= maxHold, gapWindowSize >= 3, focusSoftCap <= focusHardCap, maxUniverseSize <= 10000, universe over cap throws before allocation.

The lifecycle is three measured layers: (1) signal layer IDLE/WATCHING/FOCUS/PROPOSED/REJECTED/COOLDOWN in server/src/engine/basis/lifecycle.ts (assigned file, read in full); (2) position/plan layer CREATED..READY/OPENING/ONE_LEG_EXPOSED/HEDGED_OPEN/CLOSE_REQUESTED/CLOSING/RECONCILING/CLOSED/RECOVERY_REQUIRED/FAILED/CANCELLED/EXPIRED in server/src/foundation/contracts/execution.ts + foundation/execution/reducer.ts; (3) while-OPEN exit authority (convergence, max-hold, edge-inversion, emergency, UNKNOWN-freeze) in server/src/capitalFoundation/supervision/{common,basis}.ts. engine.ts and basisRuntime.ts (assigned, read in full) carry tick order, kill-switch/intake-pause, restart fences, and freshness. The 7-state Python collapse maps cleanly (see state_machine.python_target_mapping) provided the listed guards, the UNKNOWN-blocks semantics, and the restart query-first rule are preserved. Fixtures below feed the differential harness; they are transcribed from the repo's committed test suites, not re-executed.

rules.name: signal_state_from_decision
rules.behavior: Fold one scanner decision per tick into the symbol machine: ignore -> close focus (signal_expired) if FOCUS/PROPOSED, drop candidate, state=IDLE, correlationId=null; watch -> upsert candidate, close focus if advanced, state=WATCHING; focus -> upsert candidate, tryFocus() ? FOCUS : WATCHING (capacity denied stays candidate); proposal -> upsert candidate, tryFocus best-effort, state=PROPOSED; reject -> close focus with projected exit reason if advanced, drop candidate, state=REJECTED, and if it WAS advanced (FOCUS/PROPOSED) also cooldownUntil=now+cooldownMs and state=COOLDOWN
rules.reason: This is the candidate stage of the new machine; measured in lifecycle.ts applyDecision()

rules.name: shallow_vs_advanced_reject
rules.behavior: Only a reject that hit an advanced state (FOCUS/PROPOSED) cools down; a shallow reject (never focused) sits in REJECTED and returns to IDLE after 2*tickMs in maintain(), correlationId cleared
rules.reason: Prevents cooldown-flapping punishment for symbols that never earned attention

rules.name: cooldown_scan_suppression
rules.behavior: tick() skips any symbol whose cooldownUntilTs > now before building features; cooldown expiry in maintain() sets IDLE and clears correlation; activeCooldownCount() computes against now without requiring a tick

rules.name: candidate_ttl
rules.behavior: A WATCHING candidate older than candidateTtlMs is dropped: emit candidate_rejected 'candidate expired (ttl)', state IDLE, correlation cleared

rules.name: focus_max_age
rules.behavior: Unpinned focus session older than focusMaxAgeMs closes with exit max_focus_time and FOCUS->WATCHING. NOTE: this is signal-attention max age, NOT the position max-hold

rules.name: focus_capacity
rules.behavior: Admission under caps: existing session just rescores; pinned always enters unless everything is pinned at hard cap; above softCap only score > weakest-unpinned enters; at hardCap the weakest unpinned is evicted (exit capacity_evicted, FOCUS->WATCHING) for a stronger signal, else denied; hard cap never exceeded
rules.reason: For a one-position Python kernel a cap of 1 collapses this to 'strongest candidate wins'; keep eviction-by-score semantics

rules.name: proposal_expiry_to_cooldown
rules.behavior: onProposalExpired(symbol, why) only acts from PROPOSED/FOCUS: close focus with exit gap_closed iff why=='gap_closed' else signal_expired, drop candidate, cooldown now+cooldownMs

rules.name: proposal_invalidation_ladder
rules.behavior: Engine sweep kills open proposals in order: ttl_elapsed (now>=expiresTs); market_data_missing; book_missing (gapPct null); funding_stale; borrow_invalid (reverse only); data_quality_failed (dq < minDataQuality); gap_closed (gapPct < spec.gapClosesBelowPct = watchGapPct at creation); funding_flipped_against (carryPctOverHold < -maxFundingDragPct); data_stale (leg staleness > spec.maxStaleMs); spread_widened; depth_vanished. Each expiry feeds onProposalExpired
rules.reason: These are the candidate-stage exit reasons; gap_closed is the pre-position convergence exit

rules.name: reject_vocabulary_projection
rules.behavior: projectBasisRejectDisposition: current scanner codes and intake_paused -> focusExitReason 'cooldown'; historical risk_blocked -> 'risk_rejected' (owner FOUNDATION_RISK); borrow_required retires to borrow_unknown; account_not_connected -> ACCOUNT_TRUTH_BLOCKED (owner CAPITAL_ELIGIBILITY); anything else INVALID -> cooldown
rules.reason: Port only the current-code -> cooldown path; historical projections matter only if replaying old ledgers

rules.name: universe_retention
rules.behavior: Symbols leaving the universe: active focus closed as signal_expired, candidates/lifecycles/pins deleted, proposals expired (symbol_left_universe if gone, symbol_ineligible if present-but-ineligible), priorities and decision log pruned; engine emits universe_refreshed

rules.name: config_revision_reset
rules.behavior: Any accepted config change: expire ALL proposals (config_changed), lifecycle.resetSignals() (closes focus signal_expired, clears candidates+lifecycles, preserves pins), clear gap history, priorities, decision log, tick/heartbeat marks; universe larger than new maxUniverseSize throws
rules.reason: State derived under old thresholds is invalid by definition

rules.name: kill_switch_semantics
rules.behavior: Kill switch ON: observation and scanning continue, proposals still form; only prepareOrderIntents refuses (verdict kill_switch_on, risk_rejected event). Runtime re-applies config.killSwitch every refresh; a universe-refresh failure forces kill switch ON, empties the universe, nulls freshness
rules.reason: Fail-closed on the execution edge only; eyes stay open

rules.name: intake_pause_semantics
rules.behavior: setIntakePaused(true): expire all open proposals (intake_paused); scanner 'proposal' decisions are demoted to reject intake_paused while paused; prepareOrderIntents refuses intake_paused and expires the named proposal. Observation continues

rules.name: prepare_intents_entry_guard
rules.behavior: Execution bridge (metadata only, never places orders): sweep first; refuse intake_paused; refuse proposal_not_open unless status open/updated; validate direction in {long_spot_short_perp, short_spot_long_perp}, symbol eligible + allowed by policy + not blocked, suggestedNotionalUsd finite > 0, else expire proposal_invalid; refuse kill_switch_on; else two legs (long_spot_short_perp = BUY spot + SELL perp) at proposal notional
rules.reason: suggestedNotionalUsd=10 itself is REJECT as arbitrary dev-safe placeholder; the guard chain is KEEP

rules.name: tick_determinism
rules.behavior: tick(): for each symbol (skip cooldown) build features -> scanner evaluate -> intake-pause demotion -> correlation stamp (ignore keeps or mints idle corr; others ensureCorrelation) -> priority -> applyDecision -> proposal upsert if kind proposal -> emit strategy_decision; then proposals.sweep(fresh non-observing snapshots) -> onProposalExpired each; then lifecycle.maintain(); heartbeat every heartbeatMs; decision log capped 2000
rules.reason: Order matters: sweep after scan, maintain after sweep — the differential harness must replay this order

rules.name: runtime_cadence_freshness
rules.behavior: Runtime polls both all-symbol book endpoints every 1500ms with a 10s acquisition timeout racing the transport's 8s abort; universe refresh every 15min (also re-run on config/policy change and whenever eligible set is empty); book/mark reported 'fresh' iff age < 10000ms on a latched clock; mark goes null when no mark seen for fundingStaleMs; ledger events deduped per signature for 60s; ingestion and engine.tick() happen in the same turn so snapshot is one coherent book
rules.reason: Keep the stale windows and same-turn tick; polling cadence is deployment-specific

rules.name: latched_clock
rules.behavior: latchedNowMs() = max(lastObserved, now): a backward NTP step freezes observed time instead of making freshness ages negative (stale reporting fresh). All freshness math uses it
rules.reason: F-080 regression fix; cheap and load-bearing

rules.name: stop_restart_book_fence
rules.behavior: stop(): bump generation (cancels in-flight work), clear timers, engine.stop(), engine.resetBookContinuity() (market + gap tracker cleared) so no causal move bridges an observation outage; start(): null lastBookTs/lastMarkTs; generation ownership checked after every await

rules.name: usable_book_guard
rules.behavior: A book observation is usable iff bid/ask/bidQty/askQty all finite, prices > 0, ask >= bid, qtys > 0; unusable legs are passed as null (never zero-filled)

rules.name: plan_lifecycle_graph
rules.behavior: Position/plan machine transitions (full graph in state_machine). Design invariants: OPENING reachable only via READY; CLOSED only via CLOSING or RECONCILING; EXPIRED reachable only before capital is exposed — naked-duration expiry AFTER exposure is RECOVERY_REQUIRED, never EXPIRED; terminal = CLOSED/FAILED/CANCELLED/EXPIRED

rules.name: exposure_derived_from_leg_facts
rules.behavior: After every OPEN-phase leg event, plan state is derived only from leg facts, never optimism: isSafelyHedged (known exposure, no ambiguous leg, no over-close, no pending opening order, |normResidual(SPOT)-normResidual(PERP)| <= 1e-12) -> HEDGED_OPEN; else any fill -> ONE_LEG_EXPOSED; opening-leg rejected with zero fills while OPENING -> FAILED. Close phase: close-leg REJECTED or ambiguity-unresolved -> RECOVERY_REQUIRED; naked while CLOSING -> ONE_LEG_EXPOSED. Over-close or terminal-with-working-leg = invariant violation (event rejected)

rules.name: naked_duration_timer
rules.behavior: hasNakedExposure includes ambiguous legs AND submitting/working orders (timer starts at submission, not fill); exposedSinceMs latches at first naked event and clears when hedged; NAKED_DURATION_EXPIRED is valid only when occurredAtMs >= exposedSinceMs + plan.maxNakedDurationMs and forces RECOVERY_REQUIRED. maxNakedDurationMs is a required positive per-plan field cross-checked against declared risk terms — no global default
rules.reason: This is the position-level one-leg emergency clock at the execution layer

rules.name: restart_recovery_while_open
rules.behavior: Restore = replay the checkpointed event log through the reducer (checksum-verified). If restored lifecycle is non-terminal and any leg has submittedQuantity > 0 (or normal-basis progress demands QUERY_REQUIRED/CANCEL_ELIGIBLE/AWAIT_TERMINAL), restartRecoveryPending: every such leg must be re-verified by venue lookup on its deterministic clientOrderId BEFORE any progression; lookup timeout/contradiction emits RESTART_RECOVERY_BLOCKED -> RECOVERY_REQUIRED. Recovery recommendations are data-only, automatic:false always: AMBIGUOUS/SUBMITTING -> VERIFY_AMBIGUOUS_ORDER; open ACKNOWLEDGED/PARTIALLY_FILLED/CANCEL_PENDING -> CANCEL_REMAINDER (risk-reducing); known exposure -> CLOSE_EXPOSED_LEG (+ HEDGE_RESIDUAL when ONE_LEG_EXPOSED with exposedSince); RECOVERY_REQUIRED -> MANUAL_REVIEW
rules.reason: The restart-while-OPEN contract: query-first, never resubmit on trust

rules.name: supervision_directive_ladder
rules.behavior: While a position exists, one directive is chosen by strict priority (first match wins). Universal: position CLOSED -> HOLD; one-leg exposure > 0: reconciliation not PASS or state RECOVERY_REQUIRED -> REQUEST_EMERGENCY_UNWIND(ONE_LEG_RECONCILIATION_UNCERTAIN, deadline now); invalid common policy -> EMERGENCY_UNWIND; one-leg duration unknown or > emergencyOneLegDurationMs -> EMERGENCY_UNWIND(ONE_LEG_DURATION_EMERGENCY); else REQUEST_HEDGE(ONE_LEG_EXPOSURE) with hardDeadline = oneLegSince + maximumOneLegDurationMs. Then: reconciliation not exact / RECOVERY_REQUIRED -> FREEZE_NEW_ACTIONS (EMERGENCY if recon BREACH); thesis invalidated / max-hold breach / target reached -> REQUEST_EXIT (THESIS_INVALIDATED urgent / MAXIMUM_HOLDING_HORIZON urgent / THESIS_TARGET_REACHED routine); gross-exposure breach -> REDUCE urgent; depth or exit-capacity breach -> REDUCE elevated; outstanding-intents breach -> FREEZE. Basis-specific (only if nothing above fired): liquidation-distance or margin-distance breach or borrow RECALLED -> REQUEST_EMERGENCY_UNWIND(BASIS_CAPITAL_SURVIVAL_LIMIT, deadline now); borrow UNAVAILABLE -> REQUEST_EXIT(BORROW_UNAVAILABLE); hedge-drift breach -> REQUEST_HEDGE; remaining-edge breach -> REQUEST_EXIT(REMAINING_EDGE_EXHAUSTED); divergence breach -> REQUEST_EXIT(BASIS_DIVERGENCE_INVALIDATION); funding/borrow-rate/liquidity breach -> REDUCE elevated; ANY check UNKNOWN -> FREEZE_NEW_ACTIONS(BASIS_REQUIRED_TRUTH_UNKNOWN); all PASS + truth allows increase -> ADD_STAGE; else HOLD
rules.reason: This ladder IS the exit-reason engine the task asked for: emergency, max-hold, edge-inversion, convergence-target

rules.name: exit_convergence
rules.behavior: Two convergence facts: (a) BASIS_PATH check: sort path by observedAtMs, count the trailing run where |executableBasis| is non-increasing (count starts at 1 for non-empty); count >= requiredConvergingObservationsForAdd -> PASS (supports ADD), else WATCH — convergence gates adds, it does not itself exit. (b) The convergence EXIT is thesisAssessment.targetReached == true -> THESIS_TARGET check WATCH -> REQUEST_EXIT(THESIS_TARGET_REACHED, ROUTINE) — take-profit on gap convergence

rules.name: exit_max_hold
rules.behavior: THESIS_AGE check: age = now - thesis.openedAtMs; age >= thesis.maximumHoldingHorizonMs -> BREACH -> REQUEST_EXIT(MAXIMUM_HOLDING_HORIZON, URGENT, deadline now); age >= expectedHorizonMs -> WATCH. Horizons are per-thesis fields (validated maximumHoldingHorizonMs >= expectedHorizonMs), NOT the engine's defaultHoldMs/minHoldMs/maxHoldMs (those are funding-carry estimate bounds: 4h default, 10min..24h)
rules.reason: Do not confuse carry-estimate hold with position max-hold — separate concepts in the old code

rules.name: exit_edge_inversion
rules.behavior: BASIS_REMAINING_EDGE: expectedRemainingEdgeAfterExitCosts <= minimumRemainingEdge -> BREACH -> exit REMAINING_EDGE_EXHAUSTED; < minimumRemainingEdgeForAdd -> WATCH (blocks add only); policy requires minimumRemainingEdgeForAdd >= minimumRemainingEdge. BASIS_DIVERGENCE: adverseMove = max(0, |currentExecutableBasis| - |entryExecutableBasis|); > maximumAdverseBasisMove -> BREACH -> exit BASIS_DIVERGENCE_INVALIDATION. All values are canonical exact-decimal strings in RATIO units; policy bounds are content-addressed (revision must equal derived hash) — no global numeric defaults exist

rules.name: exit_funding_adverse
rules.behavior: Adverse funding = direction PAID and |rate| > maximumAdverseFundingRate and nextFundingAtMs <= now + fundingExitLeadTimeMs -> BASIS_FUNDING BREACH -> REDUCE (elevated), not full exit; missing/unknown funding fields -> UNKNOWN (freeze). The lead time exists to act before the next funding event, not after

rules.name: unknown_blocks
rules.behavior: What UNKNOWN blocks: any UNKNOWN check forces FREEZE_NEW_ACTIONS — no new/increasing action, ADD impossible (allTruthAllowsIncrease requires every check PASS) — but UNKNOWN never fabricates an exit, and the risk-reducing emergency ladder sits ABOVE the freeze so one-leg/reconciliation emergencies still fire. Malformed shapes become UNKNOWN, never guesses; DIVERGENT truth is BREACH, not UNKNOWN; an invalid position projection returns NO_ACTION_UNKNOWN (URGENT) and an invalid source-identity binding throws. Position state UNKNOWN is lifecycle-consistent only with capitalLifecycle UNKNOWN or RECOVERY_REQUIRED
rules.reason: Fail-closed asymmetry: unknowns freeze increases, never trigger or suppress risk reduction

rules.name: handoff_machine
rules.behavior: BasisHandoffLifecycle: exactly one already-accepted proposal claimed atomically by id (disabled/already-bound refuse BEFORE the store is touched, so no acceptance burns without a handoff); binds acceptance facts verbatim, handoffId = 'bh_'+proposalId; single-use instance. States AWAITING_FEEDBACK -> TERMINAL only; progress ONLY on matching TERMINAL or CANCEL_CONFIRMED feedback carrying a canonical non-negative exact-decimal cumulative base quantity recorded verbatim (never summed/scaled/USD-converted; never compared to acceptedNotionalUsd). Refusal order: DISABLED, NO_ACTIVE_HANDOFF, FEEDBACK_MALFORMED, WRONG_IDENTITY, REVISION_MISMATCH, ALREADY_TERMINAL, STALE_SEQUENCE, DUPLICATE_SEQUENCE, STALE_OBSERVATION (observedAtMs < boundTs or < last), QUANTITY_NOT_EXACT. Nonterminal WORKING/AMBIGUOUS/CANCEL_REQUESTED advance ordering only (AMBIGUOUS increments a counter); quantity smuggled on nonterminal is ignored. Terminal clock failure or regression throws and leaves the record wholly awaiting. Nonzero CANCEL_CONFIRMED is a first-leg terminal fact — no flatness/residual/unwind claims. Default OFF; runtime constructs it disabled with no enable path
rules.reason: This is the open->closed settlement record for the Python port's close accounting

rules.name: capital_lifecycle_graph
rules.behavior: 20-state capital graph (OBSERVED..UNKNOWN, terminal CLOSED/CANCELLED/EXPIRED) with two fail-closed gated edges in the pure guard: AWAITING_APPROVAL->AWAITING_RISK only via the approvals lane, AWAITING_RISK->READY_FOR_EXECUTION only via Foundation execution; plus a 7-stage OBSERVE..EXIT ladder where ADD requires fresh evidence + reservation + approval + future risk recheck and adverse-price-move-alone is forbidden (AVERAGING_DOWN_FORBIDDEN)
